conclusion: No critical implementation defect identified in the audited paths. The current Bernett readout has not established a pairing-specific benefit; general Vx feasibility remains unresolved.

evidence.artifact_integrity: All 8000 records and frozen source/input fingerprints verified.
evidence.upstream_equivalence: Pilot pooled features agree exactly with the upstream public forward path on three real MSAs.
evidence.cached_feature_reproducibility: Three symmetric feature vectors recomputed exactly.
evidence.pairing_sensitivity: Raw inter-chain representations change by relative L2 0.266 to 0.395 under the pilot null; joint row reorder changes 0.0083 to 0.0097.
evidence.precision: FP32 versus BF16 relative representation difference 0.0102 on the short real-input case.
evidence.null_strength: Moved indices change the actual B-chain sequence in all three checked examples; 16.1 to 26.5 percent of unmasked B-chain amino-acid cells change.
evidence.projection: The retained PCA subspace captures 80.5 percent of TRAIN and 81.3 percent of DEV standardized true-minus-shuffled feature energy.
evidence.fixed_head_control: Without refitting, the true head evaluated on shuffled features gives assessment AP 0.662865 versus 0.664361 on true features.
evidence.positive_control: On 1B70, the released contact head finds 9/10 top predicted interface contacts with true pairing and 0/10 with global shuffling.

limitations: The 1B70 contact-head test is a runtime sanity check, not independent biological validation or a test of the new Bernett PPI readout. The diagnostic contact head never contributes to Bernett pilot outputs.
The random projection and global pooling readout is a prototype; preservation of feature variation does not establish preservation of task-relevant localized interface evidence.
Only 1825 eligible TRAIN examples fit each head, and assessment contains 958 pairs; wide control-difference intervals leave plausible benefits unresolved.
All three fusion coefficients selected the upper boundary of the predeclared alpha grid. Optimal fusion outside that grid was not investigated.
Exact accession pairing is consistent with the source format, but biological ortholog/partner correctness for every queried human pair has not been independently established.
Long-query, alignment-quality and depth restrictions limit population coverage; this audit does not qualify an expanded policy.

resources.note: The half-hour audit reserve covers use of the existing one-GPU interactive allocation, including idle audit time; timed forward passes alone are not treated as allocated time.
